meaning.en: GB/T 20234.2 AC connector (China), shown as the vehicle inlet face
meaning.de: GB/T-20234.2-AC-Stecker (China), dargestellt als Fahrzeug-Ladebuchse in Draufsicht

standard.source: GB/T 20234.2 itself not consulted. Layout checked against two public drawings, retrieved 2026-11-02: Wikimedia Commons "File:GBT 20234 (AC).svg" by Mliu92 (CC BY-SA 4.0; pinout of the cable connector face, taken from the Amphenol catalogue below: outline round with a flat top, top row CC, CP (small); middle row L1, PE, N; bottom row L2, L3; the drawing uses the same geometry as the same author's "File:IEC 62196-2 Type 2 (plug).svg"), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:GBT_20234_(AC).svg, and Amphenol PCD Shenzhen, catalogue "Excel|Mate CC electric car charging coupler", page 5 "Insert arrangement" (couplers compliant with GB/T 20234.1/2/3-2015; vehicle connector and vehicle inlet seen from the front side by side: inlet with the flat side on top, top row CP, CC (small); middle row N, PE, L1; bottom row L3, L2, i.e. the mirror image of the connector face; the e-lock above the flat side is hidden, drawn dashed), https://www.amphenol.co.jp/military/catalog/GBT.pdf. The icon shows the vehicle inlet seen from the front. Keying (flat side on top) and the 2-3-2 rows agree with the Type 2 face, so the icon uses the plug-type-2 construction unchanged (R 9, flat edge at y 5, pitch 5.3, signal r 1.0, power r 1.25); left and right are not distinguished (contacts of a row have the same size). At every size it looks like plug-type-2; the app must show the name.
